subject: DPA execution + e-sign routing and signatory authority (NovaPay)
body:
From: Pete Lang <pete.lang@novapay.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@novapay.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Final DPA + execution logistics

Hi Kimberly,

Attached is our final DPA (v3) with the last small redlines from legal. We want to get this executed this week so engineering can begin the integration. Two quick questions:

1) Who will be the authorized signatory on the Redwood side (name and title) so I can set up the envelope?
2) We prefer DocuSign; do you accept countersign in DocuSign (we usually request countersign rather than manual PDFs)?

We've attached a Signatory Authority PDF that shows our GC (Elena Morris) is authorized. If you need any additional corporate docs please let me know.

Thanks —
Pete
Pete Lang
Head of Contracts, NovaPay
Attachments: DPA_NovaPay_v3-redlines.pdf, NovaPay_Signer_Authority.pdf

---

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Pete Lang <pete.lang@novapay.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final DPA + execution logistics

Pete — thanks for the upload and for flagging the authority doc.

Short answers: we can do DocuSign and countersign is fine. On Redwood's side our standard countersign flow is: 1) external party (NovaPay GC) signs, 2) Redwood legal countersigns, 3) final execution copy emailed to both parties.

Marissa (CC) from Legal will be Redwood's executing signatory unless we need an exec-level signature — Marissa is empowered for standard DPAs. Rishi, looping you for visibility on timeline for the deal.

Can you confirm the exact signer name and email for the envelope (we will set routing to require signature in that order)? Also confirm whether NovaPay needs any specific DocuSign authentication (email OTP, access code, etc.).

I'll prep the envelope and attach our internal signature block.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final DPA + execution logistics

Kim — thanks. Quick note from a sales perspective: NovaPay is on a tight schedule to get engineering started by Jan 20. If DocuSign envelope is initiated today and routing is simple, we should be able to close this week.

If Legal needs any redline reconciliation before countersign, please flag — otherwise happy to move to signature.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Growth, Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novapay.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Pete Lang <pete.lang@novapay.com>, legal@novapay.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final DPA + execution logistics

Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming signatory details for NovaPay:

Authorized Signatory:
Elena Morris
General Counsel, NovaPay
elena.morris@novapay.com

We do not require identity verification beyond email OTP. Attached is the signed Signatory Authority PDF. We're happy to receive the DocuSign envelope addressed to Elena.

Also, please include the subprocessor list appendix as a separate PDF in the envelope so our procurement team can store the signed appendix with the contract record.

Regards,
Elena
Attachments: NovaPay_Signer_Authority.pdf

---

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novapay.com>, Pete Lang <pete.lang@novapay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final DPA + execution logistics

Thanks Elena — we've set up the envelope and chosen the following routing and roles:

DocuSign envelope ID: ABC123DEF456 (https://docusign.net/envelope/details/ABC123DEF456)
Routing order and roles:
1) Recipient: Elena Morris (NovaPay) — Role: Signer (routing order 1) — email OTP enabled
2) Recipient: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com — Role: Redwood Counsel / Signer (routing order 2)
3) Recipient: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com — Role: Sales Witness (routing order 3)

Attachments included in envelope: DPA_NovaPay_v3-redlines.pdf, Subprocessors_Appendix.pdf, Redwood_Signature_Block.pdf

Notes and action items:
- Marissa: please countersign after Elena. If you want any last-minute redline reconciliation, call it out in the envelope comment and we will pause.
- Pete/Elena: once all parties sign, DocuSign will email final PDF and the audit trail to all recipients. Please confirm receipt.
- Rishi: once final is received I'll upload to the deal record and kick engineering.

I'll export a short envelope summary and drop into the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDPArefs

Thanks everyone — aiming to have this complete by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: DocuSign_envelope_summary.csv
